verdict.rationale: Databricks SQL documents a rule-to-action capability: it can monitor query results, evaluate conditions, and deliver notifications automatically. Auto Loader also processes new files incrementally as they arrive, which is event-driven processing but not user-defined rule automation. The documented action is limited to notifications, and the evidence is a single thin mention. Missing for 10: general event triggers (e.g. file arrival or table updates) that launch jobs or arbitrary actions, a configurable rule/automation engine beyond notifications, in-depth docs on alert configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
